in_hebrew.name: Haldan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haldan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Norse word halðr, meaning 'ruler' or 'leader'. In Norse mythology, Haldan was the name of several legendary kings.

in_greek.name: Haldan
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler, Leader
in_greek.long_meaning: Haldan είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old Norse word halðr, meaning 'ruler' or 'leader'. In Norse mythology, Haldan was the name of several legendary kings.

in_latin.name: Haldan
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler, Leader
in_latin.long_meaning: Haldan est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old Norse word halðr, meaning 'ruler' or 'leader'. In Norse mythology, Haldan was the name of several legendary kings.
